description: Get the trade tape for ONE option contract by its OCC symbol, active or expired, newest first: time, price, size, exchange and condition. A cancelled print stays in the tape, marked, so read volume from the bars, not a sum of prints. Defaults to the last 4 days; startDate and endDate set another window, and history begins in early 2024. A cut answer names the endTime that continues it. Plus receives trades 15 minutes after they print, Pro as they print; the Free plan is answered with an upgrade note. US tickers only.

contract.description: OCC option symbol, active or expired, e.g. O:AAPL270617C00350000

endDate.description: Last date in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: today)

endTime.description: Last time to include, in RFC 3339 format; replaces endDate

maxResults.description: Maximum trades to return, newest first (default: 60, max: 500)

startDate.description: First date in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: 4 days before endDate)

name: GetOptionTrades
title: Option Trades
